payload.title: 10-Week Intermediate Upper/Lower Strength Program (Shoulder-Safe)
payload.summary: A 4-day/week, 10-week upper/lower strength program for an intermediate lifter with full gym access, built around heavy compound lifts in the 3-8 rep range. All overhead pressing is excluded and replaced with a landmine press variant due to a confirmed shoulder impingement.

constraints.description: Mild shoulder impingement — avoid overhead pressing specifically.

safety_notes: Overhead pressing is intentionally excluded from this entire program due to your confirmed shoulder impingement.
Day 3's press was substituted to Dumbbell Landmine Press, a non-overhead angled pressing pattern, specifically for this reason.
If any exercise still provokes shoulder pain, stop and consult a physical therapist or physician before continuing that movement.
